arguments.command:
cd /work/tmp && python3 -c "
# 3125 starts x 64 lengths = 200000 records: deep nesting at every start
recs = []
for i in range(3125):
    s = (i * 7919 + 12345) & 0xffffffff00000000
    for ln in range(1, 65):
        start = s & (((1 << ln) - 1) << (64 - ln))
        recs.append((start, ln))
seen = set(); out = []
for (st, ln) in recs:
    if (st, ln) in seen: continue
    seen.add((st, ln)); out.append((st, ln))
print('records:', len(out))
import random; random.Random(1).shuffle(out)
with open('deep.txt','w') as f:
    for (st, ln) in out:
        w = [(st>>48)&0xffff,(st>>32)&0xffff,(st>>16)&0xffff,st&0xffff,0,0,0,0]
        f.write(':'.join('%x'%x for x in w) + '/%d %d\n' % (ln, st % (1<<32)))
" && time /work/submit/planb64 build deep.txt deep.idx && echo "rows=$(sed -n 2p deep.idx)" && python3 -c "
import random
rng = random.Random(3)
with open('deep_trace.txt','w') as f:
    for _ in range(200000):
        k = rng.getrandbits(64)
        w = [(k>>48)&0xffff,(k>>32)&0xffff,(k>>16)&0xffff,k&0xffff,0,0,0,0]
        f.write(':'.join('%x'%x for x in w) + '\n')
" && time /work/submit/planb64 lookup deep.idx deep_trace.txt batch 256 | md5sum && time /work/submit/planb64 lookup deep.idx deep_trace.txt scalar | md5sum
echo "=== UBSan on large inputs ==="
